statement: Implement Package H4 (invocation recovery and cancellation contract) under standard-http-service-api: scope keyed HTTP invocations to authenticated tenant, principal, and stable mount/binding identity; pin the admitted bindingVersionId at first admission on an Idempotency-Key so retries consume the pinned revision even after a mount update while new keys use the current ready revision; reject conflicting semantic inputs or conflicting explicit revision selection with INVOCATION_CONFLICT (HTTP 409); enforce the retention window with a typed INVOCATION_EXPIRED outcome; prevent automatic reruns after uncertain handler execution (INVOCATION_AMBIGUOUS, HTTP 503); and support multiple authorized waiters on an in-flight keyed invocation so a disconnected waiter detaches without cancelling work still owned by remaining waiters while cancelling when all waiters disconnect or explicit cancellation occurs.
